extracted.name: Carrot Loaf Cake
extracted.description: Great recipe for Carrot Loaf Cake.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup light brown sugar, lightly packed
8 ounce canned crushed pineapple in juice do not drain
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 lightly spray to loaf pans set aside
In a medium mixing bowl was together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and salt
In large mixing bowl with together the brown sugar and granulated sugar, vegetable oil, eggs, and vanilla extract, break up any cups of brown sugar and whiskey, until smooth
Add the crushed pineapple with juice in the grated carrots blend together using a spatula
Add the flour mixture and fold until just mixed in
Divide the batter between the two prepared pans. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Checked using a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake. Moist crumbs are OK but should not come out what
Cool for 30 minutes in the pan then remove to a wire rack to cool completely before icing

To prepare the icing combine the powdered sugar, cream cheese, butter, and vanilla in a small medium bowl. Be on low until the icing is smooth. Add a teaspoon of milk or quarter cup of confectioner sugar if needed for desired consistency.
